concerns.text: The plan assumes that the pseudo‑action reliability scores (the target) are orthogonal to the static cues (entropy, hand‑confidence, lighting, camera metadata). No evidence or citation is provided to substantiate this claim. If the dynamic reliability scores are partially derived from any of these static features, the regression analysis would be circular—training a model to predict a quantity that already contains the predictors. The methodology must either (a) verify independence (e.g., by inspecting the original ACE‑Ego‑0 pipeline or citing a source that confirms orthogonality) or (b) redesign the validation to use a target that is provably independent of the static predictors.
